a.xlink:title: Prerequisite header file for GROMACS build.
Declares GPU implementation class for update and constraints.
Implements a GpuEventSynchronizer class.
Declarations for GPU implementation of Leap-Frog.
Declarations for DeviceContext class.
Declarations for DeviceStream class.
Declares the GPU type traits for non-GPU builds.
Declaration of high-level functions of GPU implementation of update and constrain class...
Declares the GPU capabilities on a configuration specific basis.
Implements the logic for handling of DeviceBuffer types in OpenCL, CUDA and SYCL. ...
Declares GPU implementations of backend-specific update-constraints functions.
Declares special case of 3x3 matrix frequently used, and associated functions.
Declares the class for GPU implementation of LINCS.
Declares class for GPU implementation of SETTLE.
Declares common utility classes and macros.
Declares common exception classes and macros for fatal error handling.
Defines assert macros customized for Gromacs.
Declares DeviceEvent for all build configuraitons.
Basic types and macros used throughout GROMACS.
Declares GMX_CURRENT_FUNCTION for getting the current function name.
Declares MultiDimArray.
Declares real and related constants.
Declares gmx::ArrayRef.
Declares the DeviceBuffer data type.

Declares gmx::HostAllocationPolicy, gmx::HostAllocator, gmx::HostVector and gmx::PaddedHostVector, which are used to make/be standard library containers that can allocate memory suitable for transfers. Currently the only supported transfers using pinned memory are to CUDA GPUs, but other possibilities exist in future.
Declares interface to constraint code.
Declares LINCS reordering method.
Structure and basic routines to handle periodic boundary conditions.
Declare functions for host-side memory handling.
Declares functions to manage GPU resources.
Declares simple math functions.
Declares interface to SETTLE code.
C-style memory allocation routines for GROMACS.
